title: Superhuman says it has disabled Grammarly's Expert Review feature, which gave editing suggestions "inspired by" real writers without permission, after backlash (Stevie Bonifield/The Verge)
summary: Stevie Bonifield / The Verge: Superhuman says it has disabled Grammarly's Expert Review feature, which gave editing suggestions “inspired by” real writers without permission, after backlash — Now it will ‘reimagine’ the Expert Review feature, and allow experts a choice about participating in future AI plans.
contentText:
Stevie Bonifield / The Verge :

Superhuman says it has disabled Grammarly's Expert Review feature, which gave editing suggestions “inspired by” real writers without permission, after backlash   —  Now it will ‘reimagine’ the Expert Review feature, and allow experts a choice about participating in future AI plans.
